scope: Review-4 P1/P1/P2 only: conflicting prepared plan transactions, durable intent persistence, bounded learning adapter input.

observed: competing new was accepted while a migration intent was prepared
competing close was accepted while a migration intent was prepared
an unpublished node-ID reservation was ignored
plan intents did not use a flushed atomic writer
an oversized generated summary launched the delivery adapter and reported delivered

fix.pending_intent_gate: Under the existing product plan-nodes mutex, a different prepared create/migrate/close intent now fails closed before node-ID allocation or mutation; corrupt/unknown intent state also fails closed; the same intent path remains retryable.
fix.durable_intents: create/migrate and close intents use writeFileAtomicDurable. Non-Windows flushes temp bytes before rename and syncs the containing directory. Windows flushes temp bytes before the existing atomic replacement and reopens/syncs the published target; flush/publication errors propagate.
fix.bounded_adapter_input: runLearningProcess rejects JSON input larger than sharedLearningMaxBytes before executable open/hash/launch. Oversized summary delivery remains pending_delivery with the explicit callback error.

factual_product_judge.interpretation: The product-wide factual judge is not PASS. Its failures are pre-existing/global plan debt: legacy Criterion*Pending selectors, Hermes static plugin check, and goal-drift's missing prior .goal-verdict. N-040 itself is judged by its node-specific RED/GREEN checks plus independent Astra per done_when. This receipt does not claim the whole product is release-ready.

limits: A software test cannot prove NTFS rename metadata survival under sudden hardware power loss. The implementation proves and tests the controllable contract: bytes are Sync'd before publication and publication/reopen/flush errors propagate.
N-040 PASS does not close N-029..N-039, does not establish live-learning acceptance, and does not authorize installation or a live blocking proposal.
The product-wide factual judge remains RED and must be reconciled before a new stable release.
